Resolves #19671

Grid columns can opt into a value menu with `columnMenu: true`. Right-click, the sibling arrow button, keyboard and touch open one floating picker with literal option search, contextual counts and immediate checkbox filtering. Selection belongs to the Store, so shared grids and recreated headers project the same intent. Sorting, resizing and reordering retain their native paths. Existing Grid and Table inline fields now also project their exact shared contribution without echo writes.

Related: #19643

Evidence: L3 (real browser input, shared Store/lifetime journeys and normal Turbo 100k coverage) → L3 required (AC1–AC10). No leaf acceptance residuals. Parent integration closeout: Residual-Owner: #19643.

## Deltas from ticket

- The trigger is a native sibling of the sort button in a stable wrapper. The sort button retains its id; resize width and parent root-shape updates address the complete composed header.
- A common `Neo.plugin.HeaderFilter` supplies the previously missing Grid/Table read projection. NumberContainer's public configs now repaint its children without a second event; clearing the operator restores its original affordance. Untyped Auto fields remain valid inline inputs.
- Owned options use a fresh Turbo Store and a typed key-to-value map. Rebind invalidates old intents even while closed; opening waits for the header's parent render, and dismissal cancels a pending open. Floating teardown removes both DOM and owned instances. These consume existing primitives; no new facet service, count index or predicate writer is introduced.
